scripts.//: npm run --workspaces executes in directory order, not dependency order, so anything that needs the contract declarations builds them first. See docs/ADR/ADR-006-monorepo-and-tooling.md.
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @my-fit-track/api && npm run build --workspace @my-fit-track/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
